slots.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
slots.author: CoinDesk

slots.author: CoinDesk

slots.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.
